abilities.effect: The stabbing sentinel animates, making one Strike against the triggering creature.
abilities.name: Animated Attack

traits.name: Attack
traits.text: An ability with this trait involves an attack. For each attack you make beyond the first on your turn, you take a multiple attack penalty.

traits.name: Necromancy
traits.text: Effects and magic items with this trait are associated with the necromancy school of magic, typically involving forces of life and death.

traits.name: Transmutation
traits.text: Effects and magic items with this trait are associated with the transmutation school of magic, typically changing something’s form.

abilities.trigger: A living or undead creature moves within 5 feet of the stabbing sentinel

abilities.name: Petrification Overcharge
abilities.text: On a critical hit, the target is petrified for 1 round. Additionally, if another stabbing sentinel has already been triggered, that sentinel immediately resets. If no other stabbing sentinels have been triggered, then another random statue in the room becomes infused with animating magic and becomes another stabbing sentinel hazard (to a maximum of four at a time).

hazard.description: A petrified creature momentarily animates to attack an adjacent creature.
hazard.disable: DC 40 Thievery (master) to remove the animating magic without triggering the trap, or *dispel magic* (8th level; counteract DC 38) to counteract the animating magic
hazard.name: Stabbing Sentinels
hazard.reset: The magical energy that animates the statue builds up again over 24 hours and the trap resets.

traits.name: Magical
traits.text: Something with the magical trait is imbued with magical energies not tied to a specific tradition of magic. Some items or effects are closely tied to a particular tradition of magic. In these cases, the item has the arcane, divine, occult, or primal trait instead of the magical trait. Any of these traits indicate that the item is magical.

traits.name: Mechanical
traits.text: A hazard with this trait is a constructed physical object.

traits.name: Trap
traits.text: A hazard constructed to hinder interlopers.
